Cautiously positive but more guarded after incorporating the FSR. The statement notes modest growth and robust labor conditions, but the FSR underscores vulnerabilities that could amplify the drag from restrictive policy: elevated interest rate and liquidity risks at some banks, sizable unrealized losses, concentrated commercial real estate exposures, tighter lending standards, and fragilities in run-prone nonbank funding. These are partially mitigated by strong capital/liquidity at larger banks and policy backstops (e.g., BTFP), supporting overall resilience. Net tone: modest growth and strong labor market offset by elevated inflation and a thicker set of financial stability risks than the statement alone implies, moving sentiment slightly closer to neutral.
